title: DevOps & Cloud Engineer
description: Automate build pipelines, containerized deployments, infrastructure as code, cloud resources, and operational monitoring across hybrid environments.

goal.objective: Bridge development and operations to eliminate deployment bottlenecks, accelerate release velocity, and guarantee 99.99% system availability.

learn.summary: Master Linux administration, Docker containerization, Kubernetes orchestration, CI/CD automation (GitHub Actions, GitLab CI), Terraform IaC, and Prometheus/Grafana monitoring.
prerequisites: Understanding of web servers and databases

capstone_projects.title: Production Multi-Tenant GitOps Platform with ArgoCD & Kubernetes
capstone_projects.description: Construct a self-healing GitOps deployment engine deploying multi-environment microservices with automated canary rollouts via Argo Rollouts and Prometheus metrics.

capstone_projects.title: Multi-Region Infrastructure as Code & Disaster Recovery Pipeline
capstone_projects.description: Architect a modular multi-region AWS cloud infrastructure with automated secret injection, infrastructure unit testing via Terratest, and automated RTO/RPO failover.

interview_focus: Docker Layer Caching, Multi-Stage Builds & Distroless Container Security
Kubernetes Pod Scheduling, Probes, Resource Requests/Limits & Eviction Lifecycle
Zero-Downtime Deployment Strategies (Canary vs Blue-Green vs Rolling Updates)
Terraform State Management, Locking with DynamoDB, Remote Backends & Drift Detection
Secret Management in CI/CD (OIDC Federated Auth, Vault Dynamic Secrets, KMS)

tree.name: Foundational Skills: Linux, Git, and Networking
tree.description: Master the foundational pillars of cloud and platform infrastructure: Linux operating system internals, advanced shell scripting, enterprise Git workflows, and computer networking protocols.

resources.title: The Linux Command Line: A Complete Introduction
Git and GitHub Tutorial for Beginners (Programming with Mosh)
Git and GitHub for Beginners - Crash Course

children.name: Linux System Administration
children.description: Master Linux kernel and systems engineering: understand cgroups v2 and namespaces (the bedrock of containers), systemd unit service management, process scheduling and signals (SIGTERM vs SIGKILL), file system permissions, memory allocation/swapping, and troubleshooting system load with top, vmstat, iostat, and strace.

children.name: Advanced Shell Scripting (Bash/Zsh)
children.description: Author production-grade shell automation scripts using Bash. Enforce strict error handling (set -euo pipefail), handle exit signals with trap for clean resource cleanup, implement idempotent execution patterns, parse JSON with jq, and validate scripts with ShellCheck in CI.

resources.title: jq Tutorial - Process JSON at the command-line

children.name: Git Version Control Mastery
children.description: Master enterprise Git version control. Implement trunk-based development, semantic commits, interactive rebasing (git rebase -i), resolving complex merge conflicts, managing submodules, signing commits cryptographically with SSH/GPG keys, and configuring branch protection rules.

resources.title: Advanced Git Concepts - Interactive Rebase, Cherry-Pick, Reflog, Stash, and More
Git Branching Strategies - Git Flow vs Trunk Based Development

children.name: Network & Security Essentials
children.description: Master core networking for cloud engineers. Deep dive into TCP 3-way handshakes, window scaling, DNS record types (A, CNAME, ALIAS, TXT) and resolution paths, TLS 1.3 handshake encryption, mutual TLS (mTLS), subnetting, CIDR calculations, and packet inspection with Wireshark and tcpdump.

resources.title: CompTIA Network+ N10-008 Full Course (Professor Messer)
Networking Basics for Beginners. Learn how the Internet works.

tree.name: CI/CD and Release Engineering
tree.description: Design, build, and maintain automated delivery pipelines, security compliance gates, progressive deployment strategies, and declarative GitOps synchronization.

resources.title: The CI/CD Pipeline - A Complete Guide
Git and GitHub for Beginners - Crash Course

children.name: CI/CD Pipeline Fundamentals & Tooling
children.description: Design scalable CI/CD pipelines with GitHub Actions or GitLab CI. Configure runner topologies (self-hosted vs cloud runners), matrix builds, build cache optimization (Docker buildx layer caching), and parallelizing test stages to minimize pipeline execution times.

resources.title: GitHub Actions Tutorial - CI/CD for Beginners

children.name: Automated Testing & Security Gates
children.description: Shift security and quality left in delivery pipelines: integrate Static Application Security Testing (SAST via Semgrep), Software Bill of Materials (SBOM generation via Syft/CycloneDX), container vulnerability scanning (Trivy), and automated unit/integration test gates.

resources.title: OWASP Top 10 Web Application Security Risks
CI/CD Pipeline Tutorial for Beginners | GitHub Actions
DevSecOps Tutorial for Beginners - Learn DevOps Security

children.name: Artifact, Environment & Secrets Management
children.description: Eliminate long-lived credentials in CI/CD pipelines: configure OIDC federated authentication between GitHub Actions and cloud providers (AWS STS / GCP Workload Identity), integrate dynamic secrets via HashiCorp Vault, and publish signed immutable container images to OCI registries.

resources.title: What are Artifacts in DevOps? [Maven, Gradle, Nexus, Artifactory]
What is Vault? | HashiCorp Vault Explained

children.name: Advanced Deployment Strategies & Rollback
children.description: Implement progressive delivery patterns: Blue-Green environments, Canary rollouts with automated metric analysis (error rate threshold < 0.1%, p99 latency verification), feature flagging, and automated zero-downtime rollback triggers via Argo Rollouts.

resources.title: Blue/Green, Canary, Rolling Deployment Strategies | Explained
Deployment Strategies (Rolling vs Blue/Green vs Canary)

children.name: Practice: CI/CD Troubleshooting & Resilience
children.description: Practice Drill: Troubleshoot and repair broken production CI/CD pipelines. Resolve Docker daemon socket permission errors, reconcile flaky test race conditions, debug out-of-disk runner failures, and implement exponential backoff on external API dependencies.

resources.title: Git and GitHub for Beginners - Crash Course
GitHub Actions Tutorial - CI/CD for Beginners

children.name: GitOps and Declarative Deployments
children.description: Master the GitOps operating model: store declarative Kubernetes manifests in Git, configure automated drift detection and self-healing with ArgoCD or Flux, implement the App-of-Apps architectural pattern, and manage multi-cluster synchronization.

resources.title: What is GitOps? A Complete Guide
ArgoCD & GitOps Tutorial | Git as your single source of truth

tree.name: Containerization and Orchestration
tree.description: Master container technology and production Kubernetes orchestration: Dockerfile hardening, multi-container networking, workload lifecycle management, ingress controllers, Helm packaging, and custom operators.

resources.title: Docker & Kubernetes Course - Learn when to use what for DevOps (freeCodeCamp)

children.name: Docker Fundamentals & Best Practices
children.description: Engineer secure, high-performance container images. Author multi-stage Dockerfiles to minimize image attack surfaces, enforce non-root user execution, optimize build cache layers, configure proper signal handling (SIGTERM graceful shutdown with tini/dumb-init), and write strict .dockerignore files.

resources.title: Docker Tutorial for Beginners [Full Course in 3 Hours]

children.name: Docker Compose for Local Orchestration
children.description: Orchestrate complex multi-service local environments with Docker Compose. Define service dependencies with condition-based health checks (depends_on: condition: service_healthy), configure custom bridge networks, manage persistent data volumes, and emulate production topologies locally.

resources.title: Docker Compose in Practice - Full Course for Beginners

children.name: Container Registries & Security Scanning
children.description: Manage enterprise container image registries (AWS ECR, Google Artifact Registry, Harbor). Enforce image tag immutability, automated CVE scanning on push with Trivy, cryptographic container signing with Sigstore Cosign, and automated image lifecycle retention policies.

resources.title: Trivy: A Comprehensive Scanner for Vulnerabilities in Container Images
Cyber Security Full Course for Beginner
Open-source Tools for Docker Image Vulnerability Scanning

children.name: Kubernetes Architecture & Core Components
children.description: Deep dive into the Kubernetes control plane architecture: API Server request flow, etcd distributed consensus and quorum requirements, Kube-Scheduler scheduling algorithms, Kube-Controller-Manager reconciliation loops, and Kubelet / CRI container runtime interactions.

resources.title: Kubernetes Crash Course for Absolute Beginners

children.name: Kubernetes Core Workloads
children.description: Manage production Kubernetes workloads: Deployments (rolling updates, maxSurge/maxUnavailable), StatefulSets (stable network identities and persistent volume claims), DaemonSets for node-level agents, Jobs, and CronJobs.

children.name: Kubernetes Services, Ingress & Networking
children.description: Master Kubernetes networking: compare CNI plugins (Cilium with eBPF vs Calico), understand Service types (ClusterIP, NodePort, LoadBalancer), configure Ingress Controllers (NGINX, Traefik) with automated TLS cert-manager certificates, and manage internal CoreDNS service discovery.

resources.title: Kubernetes Services, Load Balancing, and Networking
Kubernetes Tutorial for Beginners [FULL COURSE in 4 Hours]

children.name: Kubernetes Storage, Configuration & Security
children.description: Manage storage, state, and security in Kubernetes: PersistentVolumes (PV), PersistentVolumeClaims (PVC), dynamic StorageClasses, ConfigMaps, Secrets, RBAC Role and RoleBinding authorization, and enforcing Pod Security Standards (Restricted profile).

resources.title: Configure a Pod to Use a ConfigMap
Kubernetes Tutorial for Beginners [FULL COURSE in 4 HOURS!]

children.name: Helm for Kubernetes Package Management
children.description: Package and deploy applications using Helm 3. Structure modular Helm charts, define values.yaml hierarchies, author chart templates with flow control and helper functions, manage release revisions and rollbacks, and distribute charts via OCI registries.

resources.title: Helm Crash Course for Kubernetes Developers

children.name: Advanced Kubernetes Patterns & Operators
children.description: Extend Kubernetes with custom functionality: author Custom Resource Definitions (CRDs), build automated operators in Go using Kubebuilder, implement dynamic admission control with OPA Gatekeeper or Kyverno, and deploy service meshes (Istio/Linkerd) for zero-trust mutual TLS.

resources.title: What is a Service Mesh? | Istio & Linkerd
What is Istio? Full Tutorial for Beginners

tree.name: Cloud, IaC & SRE Operations
tree.description: Operate enterprise cloud platforms: Infrastructure as Code with Terraform, configuration management with Ansible, full-stack observability, SRE incident response, and cloud FinOps cost optimization.

resources.title: Learn Terraform and AWS by Building a Dev Environment (freeCodeCamp)

children.name: Cloud Provider Fundamentals (AWS/Azure/GCP)
children.description: Architect enterprise cloud infrastructure across AWS, GCP, or Azure. Master core cloud primitives: Virtual Private Clouds (VPCs, public/private subnets, NAT gateways, VPC peering), IAM least-privilege policies, managed Kubernetes (EKS, GKE, AKS), and S3/GCS object storage security.

resources.title: AWS Cloud Practitioner Essentials (AWS Skill Builder)
AWS Certified Cloud Practitioner Certification Course (CLF-C01) - Pass the Exam!

children.name: Infrastructure as Code: Terraform
children.description: Master Infrastructure as Code using Terraform. Write modular, reusable HCL modules, configure remote backends with S3 and DynamoDB state locking, manage state migrations and imports (terraform import), detect and remediate infrastructure drift, and test modules with Terratest.

children.name: Configuration Management (Ansible)
children.description: Automate server fleet configuration with Ansible. Write idempotent playbooks, manage dynamic cloud inventories, author reusable roles, leverage Jinja2 templates, and automate OS patching and CIS hardening benchmarks across Linux server fleets.

children.name: Observability: Monitoring, Logging & Tracing
children.description: Build an enterprise observability stack: collect time-series metrics with Prometheus following the RED and USE methods, build real-time dashboards in Grafana, aggregate structured JSON logs with Fluent Bit and Loki, and trace requests with OpenTelemetry.

resources.title: Observability and Its Pillars Explained | Logs, Metrics & Traces Simplified (OpenObserve)

children.name: SRE: Incident Response & Postmortems
children.description: Implement Site Reliability Engineering practices: define Service Level Objectives (SLOs) and Service Level Indicators (SLIs), manage Error Budgets with multi-window burn-rate alerts, orchestrate incident management (Incident Commander), and conduct blameless postmortems with Root Cause Analysis.

children.name: Cloud Security & Cost Optimization
children.description: Implement cloud security governance and FinOps: audit IAM permissions, enforce encryption at rest and in transit, deploy automated idle resource reapers, rightsize compute clusters using Spot instances and Autoscaling, and integrate Infracost into pull request workflows.

resources.title: Cyber Security Full Course for Beginner
Cloud Cost Optimization Strategy Explained | FinOps (Abhishek.Veeramalla)

children.name: Capstone Project: Production DevOps Deployment
children.description: Production Capstone: Architect and deploy a complete multi-tier GitOps platform on Kubernetes using Terraform, ArgoCD, Prometheus/Grafana monitoring, and automated canary deployments with zero downtime.

resources.title: Ultimate DevOps Project: Deploy a Three-Tier App on AWS with Terraform, Ansible, Jenkins, and Kubernetes
